jobs.occupation: Assistant (all genders) in our EU Representation in Brussels
jobs.description:
• Provide organisational and administrative support to the Brussels team, working closely with the Executive Management Assistant  
• Assist with planning business trips, including travel expense claims  
• Help plan and organise internal and external meetings and events  
• Handle professional correspondence with the member companies, political institutions, public authorities and other stakeholders, and assist with preparing and sending mail merges  
• Manage shared mailboxes and coordinate appointments, deadlines and outstanding tasks  
• Assist with preparing and updating documents, presentations and position papers, including final quality checks  
• Coordinate the monthly eu-flash newsletter and help maintain the website and other information materials  
• Coordinate with internal and external service providers (e.g. IT and suppliers), check invoices and prepare cost summaries  
• Assist with onboarding new employees and interns 
  
• Completed vocational training as a foreign-language secretary or a comparable qualification involving foreign languages, plus several years of experience in an assistant role, ideally in an association, a political institution or a similar environment  
• Professional, courteous communication skills, with the ability to adapt to different audiences  
• Native-level proficiency in German, fluency in English and a good command of French are required  
• Confident and proficient use of MS Office, particularly SharePoint, Teams, PowerPoint and Word  
• Strong organisational and planning skills, with sound judgement in setting priorities, managing deadlines and coordinating multiple tasks  
• An independent, structured approach to work, the ability to work as part of a team, a high level of commitment and dedication, and a strong service orientation

No two days will be quite the same. You'll combine day-to-day HR responsibilities with practical health, safety and well-being coordination. 

HR – People & Organisation 
 
· Manage recruitment, interviews and onboarding of new colleagues.
 
· Coordinate payroll, absences, contracts and personnel administration.
 
· Be the first point of contact for employees' HR questions.
 
· Organise training and keep employee records up to date.
 
· Help improve HR processes as the team grows.
 
EHS – Health, Safety & Well-being
 
· Coordinate workplace safety and well-being activities with external prevention specialists.
 
· Follow up on safety procedures, risk assessments and preventive actions.
 
· Organise safety inductions, mandatory training and occupational health appointments.
 
· Maintain EHS documentation and follow up on workplace incidents.
 
· Help create a safe, well-organised working environment.
 
You won't be expected to be an EHS expert from day one. Your organisational skills, initiative and willingness to learn are what matter most.
 
 

· A Bachelor's degree or higher, preferably in HR or a related field. 

· Around 3 years of relevant HR experience, ideally combining administration, payroll support and recruitment.
 
· A working knowledge of Belgian HR administration and employment legislation.
 
· Excellent English, essential for communication with international colleagues.
 
· French and/or Dutch is a strong asset.
 
· A practical, organised and independent approach.
 
· An interest in workplace safety and well-being.
 
Above all, you're someone who takes initiative, enjoys helping colleagues and feels comfortable in a small, fast-moving team.
 
Work authorisation: Applicants must currently reside in Belgium and already have the legal right to work in Belgium. Please note that visa or work permit sponsorship is not available for this position.

A packed schedule, a hundred things happening at once and always something that needs sorting out. Sound familiar?
  
Some people find that stressful. You actually thrive on it!
  
As Management & Personal Assistant, you'll become a trusted right hand to management, providing both professional and personal support.
  
But here's what really makes the difference: you don't just get things started, you make sure they're properly taken care of, right down to the smallest detail. 
  
You'll be trusted to take ownership, anticipate needs and find solutions independently, without constant reminders or follow-ups.
  
The goal? To give management the peace of mind that when something is in your hands, it's taken care of.
  
No two days are quite the same. And that's exactly what makes this role so interesting!
  
Your responsibilities cover two main areas.
  
Management Support – Making things happen behind the scenes
    
• You manage inboxes, calendars and daily communications, ensuring everything is followed up efficiently.  
• You organise and prepare meetings, appointments and discussions.  
• You gather information, bring structure and create clear, practical overviews.  
• You keep track of deadlines, action points and ongoing projects.  
• You provide administrative and organisational support across various management responsibilities, including sales and HR.  
• You liaise with colleagues, suppliers and external partners.  
• You assist with the practical organisation of business trips, trade fairs, reservations and events.  
• When management is away, you keep things moving. You follow up on important matters, handle what you can independently and provide a clear overview upon their return.   
Personal & Household Management – Making life easier!
  
Beyond business support, you'll also help keep the personal lives of the management team running smoothly.
  
This isn't a housekeeping position. It's about coordinating, organising and taking care of practical matters that make everyday life easier.
    
• You coordinate external household help and manage the related planning and communication.  
• You arrange home maintenance, repairs, deliveries and appointments.  
• You handle practical errands and purchases for both the company and private needs.  
• You manage orders, parcels, deliveries and returns.  
• You organise gifts, flowers and thoughtful gestures.  
• You research and coordinate private travel, appointments and reservations.  
• You take care of practical arrangements involving vehicles, servicing and other everyday matters.   
And sometimes, something unexpected simply needs sorting out.
  
No problem. You focus on solutions, not obstacles!

An impressive CV? Great! But for this position, who you are and how you work matter just as much as what you've already accomplished.
  
We're looking for someone who's naturally organised. Not because they've learned to be, but because it's simply part of who they are. Someone who notices the little things, thinks ahead and genuinely enjoys bringing order to a busy day.
  
Does this sound like you?
    
• Organisation is second nature to you. You love structure, have an exceptional eye for detail and never lose sight of the bigger picture.  
• You're always thinking a few steps ahead. You spot what needs doing, take initiative and don't wait for instructions.  
• You take real ownership. When something is entrusted to you, others can count on it being handled from start to finish, without having to double-check.  
• Discretion comes naturally. You're trustworthy, reliable and understand the importance of confidentiality when professional and personal matters overlap.  
• You're hands-on, flexible and solution-oriented. You switch easily between different responsibilities and stay calm when unexpected situations arise.  
• You're a confident communicator and digitally savvy. You communicate clearly, feel comfortable with digital tools and adapt easily to different situations.  
• You genuinely enjoy making life easier for others. Knowing that someone can stop worrying about something because you've taken care of it? That's what motivates you!   
What else do you bring?
    
• A bachelor's degree and ideally some initial experience in an administrative, organisational or support role.  
• Previous experience in a similar position is a definite advantage, but the right attitude, maturity and potential to grow into the role are just as valuable.  
• Fluency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken, ideally together with good written French.  
• A valid category B driving licence.   
And the right personal fit? That's just as important to us.
  
You feel at home in a dynamic, informal environment with a relatively young team. You're positive, engaged and bring a healthy dose of common sense.
  
Ultimately, we're looking for someone management can turn to and say: "Could you take care of this?" And know it's in good hands.

jobs.occupation: Reach Truck Driver - Logent (Evergem / region Ghent, Belgium)
jobs.description:
• Safely operating reach trucks to maneuver, stack, retrieve, and store palletized goods in high-bay warehouse racks.  
•   
Handling inbound and outbound freight trucks with precision to guarantee damage-free logistics handling.
    
•   
Performing visual quality inspections on incoming goods, reporting discrepancies or damage promptly to the warehouse supervisor.
    
•   
Replenishing pick faces and staging inventory for order pickers to prevent bottlenecks.
    
•   
Maintaining clean aisles, adhering strictly to occupational safety protocols, and conducting daily pre-shift reach truck checks.
   
  
•   
You hold a valid reach truck driver certificate / license (reachtruckattest) and have hands-on driving experience.
    
•   
Fluent communication skills in English (working knowledge of Dutch is an asset) to ensure safety on the work floor and clear team communication.
    
•   
You have reliable personal transport (car, motorcycle, or electric bike) to reach our facility in Evergem independently, matching early/late or night shift schedules.
    
•   
You are available for a 2-shift rotation or a fixed night shift and align with our collective closure schedule (3 weeks in late July/early August and the Christmas/New Year holiday period).

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for orderpicker for the Bleckmann Ghent. You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year (such as Black Friday in November), you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters

• Departure at 5u10

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

Looking for a varied role in the logistics sector?Would you like to join an international working environment?Then SD Worx Jobs has the perfect opportunity for you! 

For a growing logistics company in the Willebroek region, SD Worx Jobs is looking for a Warehouse Operator.

Your responsibilitiesµ

No two days are the same! As a key player in the logistics process, you help ensure that operations run smoothly and efficiently.

• Receive incoming goods and place them in the correct warehouse locations.

• Pick and pack online orders for shipment.

• Perform quality checks to ensure high service standards.

• Monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner.

• You speak and understand English.

• Previous experience in logistics is preferred.

Michael Page is one of the world's leading specialized recruitment firms, operating in more than 35 countries. We offer a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment where ambition, performance, and personal development are truly valued.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage end-to-end recruitment processes for permanent positions.
• Develop and maintain strong relationships with candidates and clients.
• Source, screen, and interview qualified professionals.
• Advise clients on market trends, salary benchmarks, and hiring strategies.
• Negotiate offers and support candidates throughout the hiring process.
• Contribute to business development and identify new opportunities within your market.

• Bachelor's degree minimum.
• Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• Strong commercial mindset with a genuine interest in sales and business development.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
• Proactive, ambitious, and results-oriented personality.
• Previous experience in recruitment, sales, customer service, or business development is a plus.

Michael Page is a globally recognised recruitment consultancy specialising in the placement of qualified professionals and managers across a wide range of sectors, including Finance, Human Resources, Sales & Marketing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Digital & Technology, Legal, and more.

Jobomschrijving

As a Recruitment Consultant your responsibilities are:Business Development & Sales

• Identify and prospect new business opportunities within your market.
• Develop and manage a portfolio of clients across different industries.
• Conduct client meetings to understand hiring needs and business challenges.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and recruitment partnerships.
• Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers and HR stakeholders.
• Become a trusted advisor for your clients regarding talent acquisition and market trends.
Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

• Present qualified candidates to clients and manage the interview process.
• Deliver an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.
Client Relationship Management

• Act as the main point of contact for your clients.
• Provide market insights and salary benchmarking.
• Ensure a high level of service and client satisfaction.
• Develop long-term partnerships based on trust and expertise.

A successful Recruitment Consultant should have:

• Previous experience in recruitment firm
• Strong interest in business development and client relationship management.
• Entrepreneurial mindset and passion for achieving results.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
• Fluent in French and English

jobs.occupation: Country Head of IT - Global Manufacturing
jobs.description:
The hiring company is a leading global industrial and manufacturing organization with operations across multiple continents and a strong presence in Thailand. The business operates in a highly technology-driven environment, with significant manufacturing operations and a broad international network.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead the overall IT strategy and operations across Thailand.
• Act as the senior technology partner to country and business leadership.
• Ensure reliable, secure, and effective IT services across the organization.
• Oversee infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, data, end-user services, and technology operations.
• Drive technology transformation and modernization initiatives aligned with business priorities.
• Establish strong IT governance, standards, policies, and risk management.
• Lead and develop the local IT organization and technology capabilities..
• Manage strategic technology partners, vendors, and service providers.
• Oversee IT budgets, investments, and resource planning.
• Work closely with regional and global technology teams on enterprise initiatives.
• Identify opportunities where technology can improve business performance, efficiency, and scalability.
To apply online please click the 'Apply' button below. For a confidential discussion about this role please contact Gift Petto on  66 2 012 5067.

• 10  years of experience in IT, with significant leadership responsibility
• Experience leading IT within a large, multinational organization
• Strong background across IT operations, infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, and technology transformation
• Experience managing teams, budgets, vendors, and complex technology environments
• Strong business partnering and stakeholder management capabilities
• Ability to operate effectively across both local and regional/global environments
• Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline
Preferred

• Experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment
• Previous country, regional, or enterprise IT leadership experience
• Experience leading technology transformation in a complex multinational organization
• Strong understanding of cybersecurity, governance, and IT risk
• Excellent English communication skills

Our client is a global provider of biological products serving pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and CRO partners. It supplies high-quality biospecimens and cell-based solutions that accelerate drug discovery, preclinical development, and disease research.

Jobomschrijving

• Customer & Account Management: Act as the main point of contact for key accounts, ensuring accurate, timely, and high-quality communication with customers and suppliers while handling orders, inquiries, and after-sales support.
• Cross-Departmental Support & Business Development: Plan, organise, and manage workload to support business development and assist all departments with reports, data, and resources to ensure smooth operations.
• Compliance, Quality & Safety: Maintain adherence to company policies, SOPs, ISO standards, and health & safety regulations while protecting confidential information and promoting company standards.

• Ability to express fluently in English and mandarin/chinese
• Attention to detail,
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills,
• Enthusiasm, energy and determination,
• Strong organisational and problem-solving skills
• Customer oriented mindset

Our client is an established international professional services organization.

Jobomschrijving

• Map and document end-to-end processes across the different Business Services functions.
• Meet with key stakeholders to understand how processes are currently performed in practice.
• Document current-state ("as-is") processes, including responsibilities, systems, approvals and dependencies.
• Identify gaps, inconsistencies and opportunities to create clearer and more efficient ways of working.
• Develop practical future-state ("to-be") processes and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
• Create clear process documentation using tools such as Visio or PowerPoint.
• Ensure critical operational knowledge is properly captured and documented.
• Review and centralize existing supplier contracts, including ownership, expiry dates, renewal periods and key obligations.
• Review insurance arrangements and help identify potential gaps, overlaps or inconsistencies.
• Establish a practical approach for monitoring contract renewals, expiry dates and related actions.
• Collaborate with Procurement and Legal to ensure the appropriate contracts and governance are in place.
• Review and improve processes related to signing rights and delegated authorities.
• Take end-to-end ownership of deliverables and ensure the work progresses independently with limited day-to-day supervision.

• Demonstrated experience as a Business Process Consultant, Process Improvement Consultant, Business Operations Consultant or process-oriented Business Analyst.
• Strong hands-on experience with business process mapping and documentation.
• Able to conduct stakeholder interviews and translate complex information into clear and practical processes.
• Experience creating as-is/to-be process maps and SOPs.
• Previous exposure to contract management, supplier governance or operational governance is highly valuable.
• Strong analytical and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Autonomous and execution-focused: you are comfortable taking ownership and delivering the work from start to finish.
• Pragmatic and hands-on profile rather than purely strategic or advisory.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Fluent English, both written and spoken, is required.
• Knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a strong advantage.

Our client is an International Banking Institution with an established presence in Belgium.To strengthen its Compliance team in Antwerp, the organization is currently looking for a Compliance Officer who will support the Head of Compliance and AMLCO across a broad range of regulatory and financial crime compliance responsibilities.

Jobomschrijving

• Support the Compliance Manager in the execution and monitoring of the annual compliance plan
• Contribute to the review and implementation of AML/KYC policies, procedures and transaction monitoring processes
• Ensure timely and accurate preparation of regulatory reporting and returns
• Perform ongoing transaction monitoring and escalate relevant alerts and findings to the AMLCO
• Provide compliance advice to the business regarding customer onboarding, KYC reviews, transactions and risk classifications
• Review name screening alerts, sanctions and potential matches identified during customer onboarding and periodic reviews
• Support compliance matters related to corporate banking, credit facilities, syndicated lending and correspondent banking
• Perform compliance reviews and testing in accordance with the Compliance Monitoring Plan
• Contribute to the periodic review of transaction monitoring parameters and controls
• Support the assessment and review of client, country and business-related compliance risks
• Perform data quality controls across the different compliance tools and systems
• Contribute to the Enterprise-Wide Risk Assessment and other compliance-related projects

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law, Finance, Economics or another relevant field
• Minimum 2 years of relevant experience within Compliance in the financial sector
• Good understanding of AML/KYC, Customer Due Diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions and embargoes
• Previous experience within banking or another regulated financial institution is a strong advantage
• A financial crime or compliance certification is considered an asset
• Strong analytical skills with attention to detail
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with different stakeholders
• Pragmatic, proactive and solution-oriented mindset
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word
• Very good command of English is required, Dutch is a plus

jobs.occupation: Senior Key Account Manager - Transport & Logistics - Belgium
jobs.description:
Our client is a market-leading European provider of logistics, transportation, and supply chain solutions, serving major international brands across the consumer goods and retail sectors. With a strong presence in Belgium and an extensive European network, the company operates in a fast-paced and operationally complex environment where service quality, customer partnership, and continuous improvement are key drivers of success.With a strong footprint in Belgium and a broader European presence, the organisation is currently going through an important phase of growth. This creates a stimulating environment where commercial teams work closely with operational stakeholders to deliver long-term value for customers and drive continuous improvement across the business.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of major international accounts. Your primary focus will be to strengthen long-term client partnerships, ensure customer satisfaction, and identify opportunities for sustainable business growth.Key responsibilities include:

• Acting as the main point of contact for strategic customers across Belgium and Europe.
• Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders within client organisations.
• Proactively identifying risks, challenges, and opportunities to improve the customer experience.
• Leading contract renewals, commercial negotiations, pricing discussions, and volume agreements.
• Managing customer escalations and coordinating effective solutions with internal stakeholders.
• Working closely with operational teams to ensure service excellence and continuous improvement.
• Monitoring account performance, profitability, and commercial KPIs.
• Coordinating with multiple internal departments and business sites across Belgium.
• Contributing to business development initiatives within existing accounts and identifying selected growth opportunities.
• Frequent travel across Belgium, with occasional travel within Europe.

• At least 5 years of experience in a strategic B2B Key Account Management position.
• Proven experience managing large and complex customer accounts.
• Strong negotiation skills with exposure to senior decision-makers.
• Solid understanding of logistics, transportation, supply chain, or another operationally B2B environment.
• Ability to navigate complex organisations and manage multiple stakeholders simultaneously.
• Highly autonomous, proactive, and capable of taking ownership.
• Strong commercial mindset combined with excellent relationship-building skills.
• Solution-oriented with the resilience to manage challenging situations and customer escalations.
• Analytical, structured, and eager to learn.
• Fluent in French, Dutch, and English.
• Willingness to travel regularly across Belgium and occasionally within Europe.
